Setting: beneath a vast ancient oak where oaths are sworn, glowing green motes in the air, a stone castle on the ridge behind, with a detailed foreground and softly receding distance.

Gentle, soft light on her face and figure, clear atmospheric depth. No text, logo or watermark.
